validation.missing_value_policy: Preserve missing values as null on import; sum available values; do not treat missing as evidence of no cause.

definitions.arr_del15: Arrivals delayed at least 15 minutes; denominator is scheduled arrivals, including cancellations/diversions.
definitions.arr_delay: Minutes attributed to delayed arrivals in this export; not all positive delays under 15 minutes.
definitions.cause_ct: Fractional flight-equivalent allocations, NOT distinct flights experiencing the cause.
definitions.weather: Explicit weather category, NOT full weather contribution across NAS and propagation.
definitions.no_causal_identification: Descriptive aggregation only; no weather-observation join or causal effect estimation.
